newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa down, hit by technicals, sterling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa down, hit by technicals, sterling.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures fell on Tuesday, driven down by bearish technical factors and sterling's strength.
Active May last traded 13 stg down at 869 stg. May volume was 4,547 lots of a total 10,383.
Tuesday's May low of 865 stg was the lowest level the contract has seen. Its previous low was 871 stg, seen on Feb 6.
Persisting bearish sentiment in New York did not help.

Sterling's strength has pushed up values for origin sellers. "Look at sterling-french franc," was one trader's explanation of the weak market. "The Ivory Coast is a big seller and it works in francs."
